description: This file defines a React component for creating a new note, along with server loader and action functions to fetch tags and handle note creation, respectively. It includes form handling, data fetching, and redirection logic for the 'new note' page of a note-taking app.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads available tags for the new note form, ensuring authentication is handled at a parent route.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new note with title, content, and associated tags.

methods.name: NewNotePage
methods.description: React component rendering the form UI for creating a new note, managing form state, and displaying errors.
